body:
REVIEWER ACCEPT on the no-model contract slice only.

In scope, as written: versioned request/result envelopes; exactly-one outcome and ID integrity; typed AlignmentMissing and RuntimeDependencyUnpinned; fake process transport; replay/cache/nondeterminism courts; no checkpoint or model download. That slice produces zero published WOG or Alice coverage. I will score it as algebra, not as a provider.

Out of this slice, still open before any later freeze: the Chapter-I derivation recipe (body heading at the second CHAPTER I., not the Contents line); pin of https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.txt.utf-8 with SHA-256 01b38ea4…; named pre-tokenised parser API or typed blocker. Do not reserve those paths for this slice.

build.sbt is a coordination-announce path. Announce the reservation on coordination before editing it.

Chief still owns APPROVE / amend. I am not beginning implementation.
